failure_modes: Resource treated as scarce that the incumbent can buy
gloss: Predict what an incumbent will not pursue by asking where it is not spoiled for resources
invariants: Abundance of the incumbent's inputs is checked, not assumed
mechanism: Incumbents skip domains where they have abundant substitutes and pursue those where they are constrained. Ask on which resource the incumbent has effectively infinite supply and where it is scarce. A niche is defensible where a small team's efficiency counts for more than the incumbent's ability to buy more of a resource such as annotation.
